name: Average Handle Time
text: Average Handle Time is total talk time plus hold time plus after-call work, divided by the number of contacts handled. It measures how long a typical interaction takes from start to finish.

name: First Contact Resolution
text: First Contact Resolution is the share of customer issues resolved during the first interaction, with no follow-up contact needed within 7 days.

name: Quality Score
text: Quality Score is the average rating an evaluator gives a sampled interaction against a standard checklist covering accuracy, process, and communication. It is reported on a 0 to 100 scale.

name: Customer Satisfaction Score
text: Customer Satisfaction Score is the percentage of survey respondents who rate an interaction 4 or 5 on a 5-point scale. It shows how satisfied customers are right after a contact.

name: Net Promoter Score
text: Net Promoter Score is the percentage of promoters (ratings 9 to 10) minus the percentage of detractors (ratings 0 to 6) on a 0 to 10 likelihood-to-recommend question.

name: Schedule Adherence
text: Schedule Adherence is the percentage of scheduled working time that an employee is actually in the state their schedule requires. It shows whether people work when they are planned to work.

name: Occupancy
text: Occupancy is the share of logged-in time an employee spends handling contacts, including talk, hold, and after-call work, instead of waiting for the next contact.

name: Service Level
text: Service Level is the percentage of contacts answered within a target number of seconds, such as 80 percent answered within 30 seconds.

name: Abandonment Rate
text: Abandonment Rate is the percentage of customers who hang up or disconnect while waiting in the queue, before reaching an employee.

name: Average Speed of Answer
text: Average Speed of Answer is the average number of seconds a contact waits in the queue before an employee picks up.

name: Hold Time
text: Hold Time is the average number of seconds a customer is placed on hold during an interaction, excluding time in the queue.

name: After-Call Work Time
text: After-Call Work Time is the average time an employee spends on documentation and follow-up tasks after the customer disconnects.

name: Transfer Rate
text: Transfer Rate is the percentage of contacts that an employee passes to another team or line because they could not complete the request themselves.

name: Repeat Contact Rate
text: Repeat Contact Rate is the percentage of customers who contact the company again about the same issue within a set window, usually 7 days.

name: Escalation Rate
text: Escalation Rate is the percentage of contacts handed up to a supervisor or specialist for a decision, usually because of complexity, a complaint, or a policy exception.

name: Shrinkage
text: Shrinkage is the percentage of paid time that employees are not available to handle contacts, due to breaks, training, meetings, vacation, and absence.

name: Utilization
text: Utilization is the share of paid time an employee spends on productive work, including handling contacts, coaching, and approved offline tasks.

name: Attrition Rate
text: Attrition Rate is the number of employees who leave a team during a period divided by the average headcount for that period. It is usually annualized.

name: Absenteeism Rate
text: Absenteeism Rate is the percentage of scheduled shifts missed because of unplanned absence, such as sick days and no-shows.

name: Incentive Decile Rank
text: Incentive Decile Rank places each employee into one of 10 equal groups based on a composite performance score within their peer group. Decile 1 is the top 10 percent and decile 10 is the bottom 10 percent.

name: Variance to Average
text: Variance to Average is an individual's metric result minus the average result of their peer group for the same period. A positive value means above the group average.

name: Coaching Completion Rate
text: Coaching Completion Rate is the percentage of planned coaching sessions that a team leader completed and documented in the period.

name: Customer Effort Score
text: Customer Effort Score is the average answer to the survey question of how easy it was to resolve the issue, on a 1 to 7 scale. Lower effort means a better experience.

name: Compliance Score
text: Compliance Score is the percentage of audited interactions that follow all required regulatory and policy steps, such as identity verification and mandatory disclosures.

name: Cost per Contact
text: Cost per Contact is total operating cost of the service team, including labor, technology, and facilities, divided by the total number of contacts handled.

name: Contacts per Hour
text: Contacts per Hour is the number of contacts an employee handles divided by their hours logged in and available. It is a productivity measure.

name: Not Ready Time
text: Not Ready Time is the time an employee is logged in but marked unavailable for contacts. It is split into planned states, like breaks and training, and unplanned states.

name: Time to Proficiency
text: Time to Proficiency is the number of weeks a new hire takes to reach the team's target performance level after finishing training.

name: Data Freshness Lag
text: Data Freshness Lag is the time between when an event happens and when it appears in a report or dashboard. A high lag means leaders see stale numbers.

name: Data Completeness Rate
text: Data Completeness Rate is the percentage of required fields that are populated across all records in a dataset. It is a data quality check for missing values.
